reviews.rationale: MATCH applies only to the exact source-attributed opening note, selected by direct Tử Vi hosting in Huynh Đệ. 有倚靠年長之兄 describes reliance on an older brother; nương nhờ người anh lớn tuổi preserves that relationship and direction of assistance. The wording explicitly denies inferring an actual brother or actual help. The original opening has no brightness, solitary-star, sex or no-adverse prerequisite for identifying this textual statement. Its later cohost and adverse qualifications remain material to any integrated judgment and are expressly unevaluated. A host with adverse stars can select this bibliographic annotation, but cannot thereby receive a favorable sibling prediction.
limitationAnalysis: The complete Tử Vi paragraph assigns three with Thiên Phủ, three or four with Thiên Tướng, and three with Phá Quân, or different maternal births; none of these counts is asserted by this note.

The reciprocal Thiên Phủ entry requires Tử Vi plus Tả/Hữu/ Xương/Khúc for six or seven; the reciprocal Phá Quân entry gives two with Tử Vi, unlike the three in the Tử Vi entry. This genuine local numerical tension is preserved, not resolved or averaged.

The reciprocal Thiên Tướng entry includes 見殺全無 and its six-adverse closure; the Tham Lang entry gives three with Tử Vi but closes with solitude under six adverse stars. All 22 original sibling paragraphs were read.

The selected paragraph closes 加羊陀火鈴空劫克害有則欠和. Harm and lack of harmony are material qualifications; a four-adverse-absent fixture does not exclude Không/Kiếp/Kỵ, nor establish actual harmonious support.

Fixtures also reach Thất Sát and Tham Lang cohosts. Absence of a Thất Sát branch in the selected opening is not authorization to invent a combined result. Neither presence nor this annotation asserts standalone Tử Vi.

The complete natal Tử Vi material contains branch, stem, sex, entourage, adverse and limit qualifications. It was read as retained context; its Mệnh/Thân outcomes do not become prerequisites or sibling outcomes for this literal palace-opening report.

reviews.rationale: MATCH applies only to the exact source-attributed Thiên Tướng opening. 貌美賢淑 is the wife’s beauty and traditional virtue language in this spouse entry; 夫宜年長 supplies the older-husband recommendation. 親上成親 describes marriage extending an existing kin relationship. The Vietnamese wording retains all three elements and expressly disclaims personal spouse-selection advice or a factual marriage conclusion. 紫微同諧老 is a cohost branch; the reciprocal Tử Vi spouse entry says 天相同年少. This contrasting younger-age wording prevents a synthesized universal age prescription. Neither branch is evaluated by the opening-only note.

武曲少和 is explicitly reduced harmony. The reciprocal Vũ Khúc entry also has late marriage, same-age spouses, additional benefic/adverse conditions. None is erased by the opening note or inferred from it.

The closing 加羊陀火鈴空劫刑克 remains a material adverse qualification. The full natal Thiên Tướng prose, male/female/limit verses and all 23 palace paragraphs were read. Natal virtues, prosperity, harms and transformation of Liêm Trinh’s evil are not imported as proved real spouse facts.
